calibration.calibration: Unlabeled tracking only; missingness does not identify true occlusion causes
calibration.coordinate_errors: Assumed ranges; no coordinate ground truth available

fold_plan.evidence: Historical development; splitting does not create fresh confirmation
fold_plan.normalization: Fit on these training records only, separately for every learned component

hypothesis: Sparse stable contact events before and after uncertain intervals provide a time- and evidence-aware H/A bridge, recovering some short spells and turnovers without forcing an unchanged-team hold.

mechanism.D_path: No contact tokens or residual enter the player-only D logit. Candidate predictions copy the exact archived baseline P(D) and rescale only conditional H/A mass.
mechanism.control: Saved combined-objective two-seed GRU probability ensemble and exact full-provider member outputs.

memory_spec.candidate: best team control >= .2 and absolute normalized H/A margin >= .2
memory_spec.compression: median over a query-local clipped stable contact event; never summarizes across the query
memory_spec.native_masks: finite coordinates are ignored when the corresponding observed mask is false
memory_spec.query: nearest completed prior and starting future stable contact event, same block
memory_spec.reliability: same signed margin for at least .2 seconds within one continuous input block
memory_spec.source: tracking-only native ball/player observations and masks
memory_spec.time_breaks: supervised.model_periods, including half and timestamp discontinuities
memory_spec.token_support: query-local contact samples only; prior runs end before the query, future runs start after it
memory_spec.unknown_targets: not consulted; no possession target is inferred

mechanism.residual: Two-slot learned attention over prior/future event tokens with log-age and direction; tanh-bounded logit correction within +/-0.5, exactly zero when neither event is valid; final layer initializes to zero.
mechanism.training_view_parity: Regenerate clean/gap/dropout_legacy/dropout_gap with the exact archived seeds/functions and require bitwise augmented x/y/index parity against objective_alignment cached records before memory fitting.
mechanism.treatment: Freeze each matching provider-held-out combined-GRU checkpoint, hidden path, normalization and D path; fit only a small conditional H/A residual over frozen hidden/logit rows and two query-local reliable-contact event tokens.
mechanism.uncertainty: Training hidden states are produced by each frozen backbone on its own training matches; adapter training rows are not cross-fitted. Evaluation provider remains excluded from backbone and adapter labels.

metric.aggregation: Mean matches within provider, then equal mean across providers; feed_like replicates averaged within match.
metric.auxiliary: 0.70 * spell F1 + 0.30 * macro F1; not ranked

guardrails.each_provider_clean_d_f1: delta >= -.02; decoded D labels may shift under the shared unchanged Viterbi decoder
guardrails.feed_like_spell: candidate no worse than active baseline - .01

metric.primary: official greedy one-to-one possession spell F1 averaged across IoU .3/.4/.5/.6/.7
secondary: all five IoU spell F1 values
metric.tie_break: macro F1 only for exact spell-F1 ties

question: Does a zero-initialized, bounded H/A contact-memory residual improve the current combined-GRU ensemble's full-provider spell F1?
status: frozen before adapter fitting and candidate scoring

training.fits: one adapter per heldout provider and seed; no GRU or control refits
training.normalization: Reuse frozen matched backbone training-only median/std; fit no new normalization.
training.objective: Conditional H/A CE with the existing complete-native-spell duration factors plus the live-transition half of the existing .1 auxiliary. Frozen D and dead-transition losses have no adapter gradient.
training.parameter_budget: Six small residual adapters; no new recurrent, D, backbone or normalization parameters.
training.representation_cache: Frozen base hidden and H/A logits per declared window are computed once per seed/fold and retained only in process memory.
training.window_selection: Exact cached paired_records, direct/team-swapped rows and replacement-window masks.

views.stress_generator: The exact saved feed-like tracking views from the prior full-provider evaluation cache.
